introHtml: Medium multi function tools hit the sweet spot between pocket-friendly portability and full utility. Unlike smaller keychain tools that lack leverage, medium tools like the Gripper Multi-Tool or the 8-in-1 Aluminum Multi-Tool Kit offer pliers, screwdrivers, and knife blades in a size that fits comfortably in a hand or glove box. They are ideal for safety managers equipping field crews or marketing directors assembling practical swag bags for trade shows. Custom imprinting on the handles ensures your logo stays visible through years of use.
